name: Gradient ASCII
description: WebGL2 background that renders an animated color gradient as a grid of ASCII glyphs with glow, grain, an intro reveal, and pointer trail and click effects that scramble nearby characters.
contents: Container div filling its parent with one absolutely positioned canvas
Gradient field rendered offscreen, converted to ASCII glyphs from a font atlas, with blurred glow halo and grain
behavior: Gradient shape drifts and warps continuously with noise, speed controlled by speed
Intro reveals glyphs over about 2.4 seconds
Pointer movement anywhere in the window leaves a trail that scrambles characters under it while over the container
Click or tap inside the container triggers a wave ring or burst of scrambled characters
Glyphs flicker and swap characters over time
Pauses rendering when offscreen or the tab is hidden
With reduced motion enabled, animation, flicker, intro and pointer effects are disabled and a static frame is drawn
Resizes with its container, pixel ratio capped at 2

props.name: fontFamily
props.default: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

editableByProps: Gradient colors (up to 8), shape, softness, scale, flow, speed, and seed variation
Character set, cell size, density, glyph opacity, flicker, depth of field, and font family
Glow, gradient opacity, and grain amounts
Pointer trail on or off, scramble radius, click effect, and intro on or off
Light mode with dark glyphs on a light background, pixel ratio, className and style

needsCodeEdit.where: SHAPES constant and the shape functions plus main dispatch in the FIELD shader

needsCodeEdit.change: Change pointer trail length or lifetime
Change click effect duration or number of simultaneous clicks
Limit pointer tracking to the container instead of the window
needsCodeEdit.where: pointermove and pointerdown listeners on window in the main useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unsupported or shaders fail to compile
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent must have a height
Pointer and click listeners are attached to window, and the canvas is aria-hidden
Maximum 8 colors, 4 simultaneous clicks, and 24 trail points
Values for numeric props are clamped to internal ranges
Unknown shape falls back to horizon and unknown clickEffect falls back to wave
Only the first render's effect runs setup; prop changes are read live through a ref
Defaults use the Geist Mono font, which must be loaded by the page, otherwise it falls back to the system monospace
Uses a transparent canvas background, so page content behind shows through
Sizes from its container with a resize observer and works on small screens, though a small cellSize is heavy on mobile GPUs

options.look: Curved glowing arch rising across the lower half like a sunrise horizon

options.look: Large glow rising from the bottom edge
options.useWhen: Footer or call-to-action section where light should lift from below

options.look: Dark disc with a glowing corona and noisy rays around it
